text: The bug is in `page_count`: `total_items // per_page + 1` always adds an extra page, so when the item count is an exact multiple of `per_page`, a phantom empty page is created. The correct ceiling division formula is `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page`, and as noted in the docstring, it should be at least 1 (an empty collection still has 1 page).
